content: What is the current status and intended direction for proving total correctness in iris-lean? I noticed that TotalWp and its notation exist, but I couldn’t find a semantic implementation, proof rules, or an adequacy theorem establishing termination. I’d be interested in contributing this if it is planned and no one is currently working on it. My intended use case is proving properties of WebAssembly code, which is currently non-concurrent and has relatively straightforward termination arguments.
I'm currently working with a barebones definition of TotalWp to test my automated fixpoint solver, but I don't think there's anyone working on it specifically
One example of a total wp is in https://github.com/markusdemedeiros/Metrology/blob/main/Metrology/TotalEris/TotalWeakestpre.lean, though for the eris program logic
(Indeed, but this does not port the main total wp results from Iris)

I opened this PR (it was mostly written by AI), and I started using it in our project here: https://github.com/cajal-technologies/talos/pull/166, that is some validation about this implementation.

I'll appreciate any comments on the PR.
